question: If selling price and cost price of a shirt is Rs. 945 and Rs. 750 respectively, then what is the profit percentage?
solution:

Selling price and cost price of a shirt is Rs. 945 and Rs. 750 respectively

Selling Price (Sp) = Cp + (Profit /100) × Cp

Profit percentage = (Profit / CP) × 100 

Calculation:

As per the question,

Net profit is 945 - 750 = 195

Profit percentage will be,

⇒ (195 / 750) × 100 = 26%
